reason: lib/validators/email_validator.rb:19-21 builds `Regexp.new("@(#{domains})", true)` with no `\z` or boundary anchor, so `user@example.com.evil.com` matches a whitelisted `example.com` and passes the check at line 5. The method was moved verbatim from app/models/user.rb by this patch, so the flaw is carried over rather than new.
